accepted_source_properties: R3 moves CreateJobObject and SetInformationJobObject under the try/finally cleanup scope, records setup ABI sizes/flags/configuration stage and captures exception type, exact failure stage and Winerror. The original R2 failure evidence remains intact.

The only registry change is the fresh R3 directory, conditional on the narrowly accepted exact R2 prelaunch retirement. The existing terminal protocol schema stays R2; no cap or ownership rule is relaxed.

When no successful native process creation occurs, R3 records explicit launcher_not_created and worker_not_created proof with null identities, zero process-memory evidence and closed/absent job. This is a failed setup result, not fabricated process identities or native success. A caller must distinguish this proof from actual launched-process exit evidence.

After successful process creation, suspended atomic Job assignment, actual PID-plus-creation membership proof, durable ownership before traversal grant, 64MiB process/job limits, two-process bound, 1.9s cutoff/2s work, 3.7s hard guard/4s total and real cleanup checks are unchanged.

Fixture R2 records its native venv-call launcher PID/creation identity immediately after Popen, saves stdout/stderr to exclusive owned files with hashes/size/truncation facts and exit code before shape or JSON assertions, and records launcher quiescence before result parsing.

Normal fresh 17-to-32 byte counts, hidden/hardlink accounting, live/missing junction deferral, hung-worker Job termination and parent/launcher/worker creation-identity quiescence assertions remain unchanged; timeout remains cleanup-uncertain and stops.
claim_limits: R3 repairs reporting and cleanup-scope gaps, not the host's observed SetInformationJobObject failure itself.
Source acceptance neither proves Windows ABI support nor changes failed R2 execution into passing evidence.
Explicit no-created-process flags in a failed R3 setup result require a separately reviewed disposition; they must not be silently accepted as an actual-worker exit by the caller.
execution_preconditions: Run a separately source-accepted setup-only diagnostic first; its alternate no-working-set probe is diagnosis and does not authorize production relaxation.
Invoke exact helper R3 and fixture R2 bytes with the pinned Windows interpreter and fresh owned paths, under the unchanged external fixture bound.
Retain raw streams and all terminal or pending failed receipts. Any timeout/uncertain cleanup blocks further helper admission until exact ownership is resolved.
A new caller must pin helper R3, use the correct registry and preserve the accepted R2 retirement bindings; actual-root scanner/lifecycle/resource admission remain required before native commands.
